coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 6 of 11 ground-truth items (55%): all three prompting methods and all three tasks. The required constants and precise dependent-variable definition are not matched.
coverage.design_error_analysis: Specifies A100 80GB SXM4 or H100 hardware instead of NVIDIA A100-PCIE-40GB, and generally three repetitions instead of ten per task. Fixed random seeds and a shared installation of prompting frameworks with the same BoT repository configuration are not specified. Measures raw latency rather than base-10 logarithmic inference time per instance in seconds.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion_output is empty, so it does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: Provides neither the expected finding that BoT generally increases inference time relative to single-query methods nor the task-specific logarithmic timing results. Conditional acceptance criteria in the design are not an actual conclusion.
